Hi Catherine / Samuel —

Thanks for signing up for the self-serve trial and for the quick positive feedback in the form submission. Marcus (AE) and Hiro (SE) are available to do a 45‑minute product preview next week. Before we lock a time, a couple quick notes so we bring the right setup for your team:

- We typically run a 30–45m session: 20m product demo + 15m Q&A. For security and SSO questions we like to include a short IT sync (10–15m) either before or after the demo.
- Marcus prefers a demo during his morning (PST); Hiro can cover technical deep dive either jointly or as a follow-up slot.
- Could you confirm whether you want the IT/security person (Samuel) on the live demo or on a separate technical bridge?

Proposed windows (I included a .ics):
- Option A: Tue Sep 1, 9:00–9:45am PDT / 12:00–12:45pm EDT
- Option B: Tue Sep 1, 2:00–2:45pm PDT / 5:00–5:45pm EDT
- Option C: Wed Sep 2, 8:00–8:45am PDT / 11:00–11:45am EDT

I attached a short security checklist and a set of IT questions Samuel can scan ahead of time (attachments). If another time range works better, drop two windows and we’ll slot around it.

Thanks —
